modules.title: Modules
modules.intro: Turn on only what your club needs. Turning a module off hides its screens and fields without deleting anything: the data comes back if you turn it on again.

distances.name: Distances
distances.description: Record the kilometres covered on every outing.
distances.adds: Adds a distance to routes, a prefilled and editable distance when an outing ends, and kilometres in the logbook and statistics.
distances.suggestion: Want to track kilometres? The Distances module adds a distance to each route and carries it into outings.

outingTypes.name: Outing types
outingTypes.description: Tell training, regattas, camps, tours… apart, and record outings over several days.
outingTypes.adds: Adds a type choice at departure, an end date for outings over several days, and the type in the logbook and exports.
outingTypes.suggestion: Want to tell training, regattas or tours apart in the logbook? The Outing types module does that.

memberProfile.name: Full member profile
memberProfile.description: Keep your members' contact details and information in one place.
memberProfile.adds: Adds separate first and last names, gender, birth date, licence number, email, phone, address and status (member, guest, other).
memberProfile.suggestion: Need an email, a licence number or a birth date? The Full member profile module adds these fields.

guests.name: Guests
guests.description: Add someone who is not in the rower list when an outing starts.
guests.adds: A name typed at departure creates a “guest” record hidden from the rower list; its outings stay in the logbook and the record can later be completed or turned into a member.
guests.suggestion: Guests or visiting rowers? The Guests module lets you type their name at departure without creating a member.

captain.name: Captain
captain.description: Name the person responsible for the crew during the outing.
captain.adds: Adds a captain choice among the crew at departure (the cox, otherwise the first adult rower, is suggested), shown in the logbook and exports.
captain.suggestion: Want to know who is responsible for each boat on the water? The Captain module adds it at departure.
captain.requiredOption: Require a captain to start an outing

damages.name: Damages
damages.description: Report damage to a boat with its severity, follow it until it is repaired, and warn the crew before they set off.
damages.adds: Adds a Damages tab to the logbook, damage reports from an incident or a boat's page, a warning at departure for damaged boats, and each boat's damage history.
damages.suggestion: A damaged boat? The Damages module lets you report the damage, follow its repair and warn the crew at departure.

reservations.name: Reservations
reservations.description: Reserve a boat for a regatta, a course or a weekly training session.
reservations.adds: Adds a Reservations page, a “reserved” label on the boats concerned in the boathouse, and a notice when an outing would overlap a reservation. Starting an outing is never blocked.
reservations.suggestion: Need to keep a boat free for a regatta, a course or a regular slot? The Reservations module shows it in the boathouse.
reservations.lookahead: Show a boat as reserved {{minutes}} minutes before

reservations.emptyText: Reserve a boat for a regatta, a course, a group outing or a slot that comes back every week. In the boathouse the boat shows as reserved, and a notice appears if an outing overlaps the reservation, without ever stopping anyone from going out.
